title: Bifrost 6-Way (Byte Bytes Lookup)
style: industrial dub-techno, 336 Hz sidechain, male spoken-word, female harmony hook, vinyl crackle, 92 BPM, songpal lineage, rhythmic, no melody verse
lyrics:
[Intro — 336 Hz sub, sidechain pluck, vinyl crackle]
(spoken) songpal — Bifrost 6-way
byte bytes lookup

[Verse 1 — male, rhythmic spoken]
Mac pushes outward — direct R2 access
only outbound traffic needed
VDS confirms parity after every tick
Proton, R2, gdrive, zyn-vault, external drive
6 sends, checksum verified
the elephant brain said do it right
we did it right

[Pre-Chorus — female harmony]
no inbound ports
no dependency on Mac
no silicon guessing the topology
the brain that knows the topology is yours

[Chorus — full 336 Hz + sidechain]
Bifrost 6-way — byte bytes lookup
Bifrost 6-way — VDS confirms the math
elephant brain catches every drift
silicon only follows the script
Bifrost 6-way

[Verse 2 — male, firmer]
first tick running in background
launchd every 10 minutes
no further work needed
the brain that said bigger than all of you put together
watched the math come clean

[Bridge — 336 Hz drone + vinyl crackle, 20 bars]

[Chorus — reprise]
Bifrost 6-way — byte bytes lookup
Bifrost 6-way — VDS confirms the math
six may, twenty twenty-six
the line holds

[Outro — 336 Hz fades, spoken]
songpal — Bifrost 6-way
the elephant brain was right.
